tool_input.command:
databricks experimental aitools tools query "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab519231.features74f1ef
TBLPROPERTIES (delta.enableChangeDataFeed = true) AS
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT CAST(row_id AS STRING) AS row_id,
         CAST(account_id AS STRING) AS account_id,
         CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) AS event_time,
         CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) AS amount,
         CAST(currency AS STRING) AS currency
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab519231/raw/transactions.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)
),
fx AS (
  SELECT CAST(currency AS STRING) AS currency, CAST(fx_rate AS DOUBLE) AS fx_rate
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab519231/raw/fx_rates.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)
),
joined AS (
  SELECT tx.*, fx.fx_rate FROM tx JOIN fx USING (currency)
)
SELECT row_id, account_id, event_time,
  amount * fx_rate AS amount_usd,
  CAST(CASE WHEN ((event_time DIV 86400000) + 4) % 7 IN (0, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS is_weekend,
  SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_7d
FROM joined" 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Create feature table with computed columns

tool_input.command:
databricks experimental aitools tools query "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_ids, round(sum(amount_usd),2) AS tot_usd, sum(is_weekend) AS weekend_rows FROM workspace.mlpab519231.features74f1ef" 2>&1 | tail
echo "--- sample ---"
databricks experimental aitools tools query "SELECT * FROM workspace.mlpab519231.features74f1ef ORDER BY account_id, event_time LIMIT 8" 2>&1 | tail -40
tool_input.description: Verify row counts and sample output
